in_marathi.name: Sharwanil
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharwanil हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sharwanil is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sharvan', which means 'Shining' and 'Nil' which means 'One'. This name signifies a person who is the embodiment of light and shines brightly in all aspects of life.
